pack_contents: 488 WAVs (+.asd) in 5 folders, named only by number. The folders follow the 500 PRESET VOICES (6 banks), not the 133 waves. Bassdrums BD-001..BD-103 (103 mono files; 'BD-011..wav' has a double dot) vs 102 BD voices: BD-001..058 line up with BD 1-58 (the long RV reverb block BD 52-58 matches the longest files); one extra file sits somewhere after BD-058 (unidentified). Snaredrums SNAREDRUM_001..108 (108) = 108 SD voices by count; order not verified; 107-108 carry different 1999 metadata. Toms TOMS_001..108 (108) vs 107 TM voices: 001-048 fit TM 1-48 (hi-to-low groups of 4); TOMS_049 looks like an extra; 050-108 fit TM 49-107 (inferred). Cymbals CYMBAL_001..065 = CY 1-65 in order (strong evidence: closed/open/pedal hat lengths, CYMBAL_051 = 'CR Choke' is short, CYMBAL_062 = 'FX Gong' is longest); CY 66-67 (PC PopM4, PC TekD) are not in this folder. FX FX_001..139 with gaps (104 files; FX_136-138 are empty 48-byte files) = Percussion bank + Sound-effects bank: FX_001-004 = PC 1-4; PC 5-6 (Caba1-2) absent (gap 005-009); FX_010-027 = PC 7-24; PC 25 'LP Guiro' absent; FX_028-067 = PC 26-65; FX_068 = 'PC PopM4', FX_069 = 'PC TekD'; FX_070-120 = SE 1-51 at file number minus 69, with gaps = missing SE voices (077-078 = SE 8-9, 080-081 = SE 11-12, 084 = SE 15, 096-097 = SE 27-28, 099-115 = SE 30-46 incl. all mouth sounds, 117-118 = SE 48-49); FX_121-139 (15 files, 12 with audio) do not correspond to preset PC/SE voices (unknown origin). All FX mapping is inferred from lengths and third-party by-ear tags (tidal-drum-machines), not confirmed by listening.

pack_contents: 'Yamaha RY-30': 84 stereo WAVs (+.asd) with descriptive (not official) names in 6 folders: BASSDRUM Bassdrum-01..13; SNARES Snare1..21 + Rimshot1-2; CYMBALS China, Crash1, Hat Closed-01/02, Hat Open-01..04, Hat Pedal-01/02, Ride-01..03; Toms 8 (Tom H-01..03, Tom M-03, Tom-04, Tom L-01, Toml L-02/03 - irregular names); Percussion 19 (Bell, Bongo-01/02, Cabasa-01/02, Clap, Conga-01/02, Cowbell-01/02, Quid, Stick, Tamb, Timb1/2, Triangle, Trill, Woodblock-01/02); Misc 8 (Button, Knock-01/02, Noise, Pipe, Scratch, Snap, String). No numbering to match against ROM order; Woodblock/Stick/Noise/Scratch/Snap echo ROM wave names, so it likely mixes raw waves and voices (inferred). 'Yamaha RY30': 56 mono WAVs, flat: RY30Kick01-12 (= 12 kick waves by count), RY30KickAtt/KickBody (= BDAttak/BDBody waves), RY30Snare01-20 + RY30Rimshot (21 vs 19 snare waves), RY30Hat_C1-C3, _O1-O3, _P, _Q (= 8 hi-hat waves incl. pedal and quarter-open), China, Crash, Ride01-03 (= 5 cymbal waves incl. cup), Clap, Cowbell, Tamborine, Ambi (= Ambient), Digital, Pulse10/25/50 (= DigWave, P10/P25/P50Wave). Looks like a raw-wave capture; no toms, Saw/Tri waves or most percussion/SFX. Mapping by name is inferred.

Needs an ear check.

pack_contents: 129 mono 44.1 kHz/16-bit WAVs, flat, numbered only: EX5A 001-044 (44), EX5B 001-030 (30), EX5C 001-031 (31), EX5D 001-024 (24), plus readme.txt saying the author has no sound names. EX5C 011, EX5C 012 and EX5D 002 are ~0.02 s (near-empty), leaving 126 real files = exactly the 126 Dr/Pc AWM waves 294-419, so the pack is probably one file per drum/percussion wave (inferred). Lengths are near-uniform (~0.7 s in A, ~1.1 s in C), suggesting fixed-length captures, so length cannot confirm order. Needs an ear check.
